TEXT_1_D4_status: NOT RECONCILED. A constant offset of one is consistent with a differing cycle convention (counting completed cycles versus counting heel-strike intervals, or applying the drop-last rule versus not), but which file uses which convention is not recorded in either, and no deposit states the definition. This is recorded as an open discrepancy rather than resolved by assertion.

TEXT_2_CONVENTION_IDENTIFIED_r308.cross_check: PERCYCLE_r279.json per_cell.S.101.n_cycles = 13, siding with convention B.
TEXT_2_CONVENTION_IDENTIFIED_r308.ADOPTED: Convention B is adopted as the project's cycle count, because three deposits use it including the per-cycle source file, against two that use A.
TEXT_2_CONVENTION_IDENTIFIED_r308.no_conclusion_changes: Disjointness of the cycle-count comparison holds under both.

THE_CONTRADICTION: D4_status says the discrepancy is NOT RECONCILED, that which file uses which convention IS NOT RECORDED in either, and that NO DEPOSIT STATES THE DEFINITION. CONVENTION_IDENTIFIED_r308 then assigns each file to a convention and declares one ADOPTED. These cannot both be live: the second does exactly what the first says cannot be done from the available record.
THE_ADOPTION_CLAIMS_BASIS_IS_A_VOTE_NOT_: The stated ground is 'because three deposits use it including the per-cycle source file, against two that use A'. Counting how many files exhibit a behaviour does not define the behaviour. A majority can be wrong, and more to the point a majority cannot say WHAT IS BEING COUNTED.

AND_THE_CENSUS_IS_INCOMPLETE.claim: The 3-versus-2 tally omits files that also carry cycle counts, so even as a vote it is not a complete one.
AND_THE_CENSUS_IS_INCOMPLETE.note: GAIN_LADDER_r264.json and YAW_RECOVERED_r309.json both carry cycle-count fields and appear in neither column of the tally. Whether their counts follow A or B was NOT determined here -- doing so would require defining the conventions, which is precisely what no deposit does. What IS established is that the census omitted files that count cycles.

WHAT_IS_NOT_ESTABLISHED: NO DEPOSIT ANYWHERE DEFINES EITHER CONVENTION. A definition would have to state what is counted: completed gait cycles versus heel-strike intervals, and whether the last cycle inside the window is dropped. No file states this. Until one does, 'convention B' NAMES A BEHAVIOUR NOBODY HAS WRITTEN DOWN -- it is a label for an observed offset, not a rule anyone could apply to a new measurement.

CENSUS_METHOD_CORRECTION_r333.three_wrong_counts: The coordinator counted 5 live citations by key path, the watchdog counted 3 by presence, and the r333 scan counted 1 by requiring the manuscript name in the same STRING as the line number. All three were wrong.

CENSUS_METHOD_CORRECTION_r333.CORRECT_METHOD: Classify by KEY PATH for live-vs-subordinate, and match the file reference across BOTH key and value. Neither alone is sufficient.
CENSUS_METHOD_CORRECTION_r333.ENUMERATING_THE_DEFECT_CREATES_IT: DEFECT_LIST_REVALIDATED_r332.json carries 3 line citations and LMRONLY_r223.json 3 more, all produced BY recording the defect. A census written as prose cannot avoid this: to say which line is wrong it must name the line.
CENSUS_METHOD_CORRECTION_r333.IS_THERE_A_FORM_THAT_COULD: YES for new records: a structured field holding {file, anchor_text} instead of a sentence quoting a line number is immune, because it names no line. It does NOT help where the record must quote a historical citation verbatim to show what was wrong -- those quotations are evidence and must stay. So the defect is avoidable going forward and irreducible in the audit trail.
